result.title: AgentMemGate: Addressing Speculation Contamination in Conversational Assistant Memory
result.comment: Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures
result.summary: Conversational AI assistants with long-term memory extract facts from user messages into a store consulted in later conversations. A stated plan can enter that store as fact: a user who might move to Seattle may be recorded as already living there. We call this speculation contamination. Final-state memory benchmarks miss this error because they do not probe intermediate state and include few unresolved speculations. We present AgentMemGate, a write-time gate for profile-store memory that classifies extracted statements as speculation, completed event, correction, or other. Speculations remain outside memory, with conditions governing later promotion or deletion. We also contribute a dataset of multi-session conversations in which plans are confirmed, abandoned, or left unresolved. On our 147-conversation held-out set, Mem0 and Graphiti assert unresolved plans as current state for 35.2% and 27.3% of pending plans. On the core benchmark, AgentMemGate eliminates all observed contamination relative to the identical ungated pipeline (87.5% to zero for the most exposed extraction style) and raises task accuracy from 65% to 95%. On the harder held-out set, gated contamination is 3.4% to 5.7% and task accuracy rises by 9 to 13 percentage points. Our analysis identifies field matching as the main remaining bottleneck: realistic speculations often match no profile field and never reach the gate. We release our datasets, prompts, and evaluation code.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究对话助手长期记忆中的「推测污染」：把用户尚未实现的可能性（如可能搬到西雅图）误记为既定事实，并提出写入门控 AgentMemGate，将抽取语句分类为推测、已完成事件、纠正等，使推测暂不进入记忆并附条件以决定后续提升或删除，同时发布多会话数据集与评测代码。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其以「暂缓写入＋条件性提升/删除」处理未确定信息的概念，可能启发 VLM 推理中 latent 假设与视觉证据状态的暂存、筛选与提交决策，可供核查其门槛判据与状态管理设计。
